{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Remove rows with sentinel value -999 in baseline
# This is critical because -999 is clearly a placeholder for missing data
trial_clean = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Verify the clean dataset
print("Clean dataset shape:", trial_clean.shape)

# Check if the treatment arm has more severe cases
print("\nSeverity distribution by arm in clean data:")
print(trial_clean.groupby('arm')['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True))

# Check response rate by arm
print("\nResponse rate by arm:")
print(trial_clean.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean())

# Check baseline biomarker by arm
print("\nBaseline biomarker by arm:")
print(trial_clean.groupby('arm')['biomarker_baseline'].mean())

# Check final biomarker by arm
print("\nFinal biomarker by arm:")
print(trial_clean.groupby('arm')['biomarker_final'].mean())

# Check if the biomarker improved in treatment arm
print("\nBaseline vs Final biomarker in treatment arm:")
print(trial_clean[trial_clean['arm'] == 'treatment'][['biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final']].mean())

print("\nBaseline vs Final biomarker in control arm:")
print(trial_clean[trial_clean['arm'] == 'control'][['biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final']].mean())"}
